subject: Interim SOC 2 attestation + procurement cutover checklist (renewal Q3)
messages:
From: Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@helixpartners.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@helixpartners.com>
Date: 2024-06-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 coverage for renewal (timeline + bridge/attestation)

Hi Jonas,

We're in the final stages of our Q3 renewal review for Helix Partners and Procurement needs to confirm SOC 2 coverage before we sign the renewal P.O. Contract effective date is planned for 2024-09-01. Our procurement policy requires one of the following: the most recent SOC 2 Type II report covering an audit period that includes at least up to 2024-06-30, or an interim bridging/attestation letter that extends coverage to 2024-09-01 if the report's audit window ends earlier.

Could you confirm the latest SOC 2 Type II audit period you have on record, and whether Redwood can provide either: 1) a current Type II that meets the coverage window, or 2) an interim attestation / bridge letter we can accept for the renewal cutoff?

We also have a short procurement cutover checklist (IT security acceptance, contact for SOC evidence, invoice/payment milestone) that we'll need completed before PO execution. If you can, please include an estimate for how long it will take to produce an interim attestation and what evidence we should expect to receive.

Thanks — we're trying to close the renewal the week of 2024-07-01.

Best,
Sarah Collins
Senior Procurement Lead
Helix Partners

Attachments: None in this message
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@helixpartners.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: 2024-06-14T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 coverage for renewal (timeline + bridge/attestation)

Hi Sarah — thanks for the note and the timeline. Short answers up front: we have a SOC 2 Type II report for audit period 2023-01-01 through 2023-12-31 (Redwood_SOC2_Type_II_2023.pdf). That report does not cover into mid-2024, but we can provide an Interim Attestation Letter that bridges controls coverage through your renewal effective date.

Plan / asks:
- We'll produce an interim attestation (signed by our Security/Compliance lead) that confirms control coverage and any material changes since the last report. Target delivery: 2024-06-17 EOD.
- Karthik (CC) will enumerate the minimal evidence/proof points Procurement requires (scope, user access reviews, incident summary, third-party risk checks).
- Priya (CC) will align on the procurement cutover checklist and any billing/milestone items.

Sarah — can you confirm Helix Partners is willing to accept the interim attestation plus the Type II pdf as evidence for the 2024-09-01 renewal? If Procurement requires a formal 'bridge letter' with specific wording, please paste the required language or upload a template and we'll accommodate.

I'll follow up with the interim attestation and the cutover checklist attached.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com
(Attachment planned: Interim_Attestation_Letter_2024-06-17.pdf; Procurement_Cutover_Checklist.xlsx)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@helixpartners.com>
Date: 2024-06-15T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 coverage for renewal (timeline + bridge/attestation)

Jonas / Sarah — quick technical note on scope and evidence so Procurement knows what to expect.

What the interim attestation will cover:
- Confirmation that Redwood controls in scope for previous Type II remained in place and materially unchanged from 2024-01-01 through 2024-06-30.
- Call-out of any small operational changes (none that affect control design materially at present).
- Statement that no material security incidents affecting control outcomes occurred in the interim window.

Typical evidence we will provide alongside the attestation (redacted where required):
- Copy of Redwood_SOC2_Type_II_2023.pdf (full report)
- Executive summary of control changes since the report (one page)
- Access review sample (redacted) and summary of privileged account controls
- Incident summary covering 2024-01-01 to 2024-06-30
- List of third-party assessments and vendor SOC status relevant to Helix integration

Timeline constraints: we can produce the Interim_Attestation_Letter_2024-06-17.pdf and the evidence bundle by EOD 2024-06-17 if legal approvals sign off quickly. If Procurement needs additional attestations (e.g., full SOC 2 Type II for a 2024 audit period), that will require scheduling a new audit and cannot be accomplished before your 2024-09-01 renewal date.

Legal note: the attestation is suitable for procurement acceptance in most SaaS contracts, but if Helix requires a bridge letter with specific contractual language (liability carve-outs, indemnities), we should review with Legal.

I'm attaching a one-page evidence checklist for Procurement review.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
(Attachments referenced: Evidence_Checklist_Interim_2024.pdf)
From: Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@helixpartners.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@helixpartners.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: 2024-06-17T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 coverage for renewal (timeline + bridge/attestation)

Jonas / Karthik / Priya — thank you for the quick responses and the plan.

Procurement reviewed the interim materials and confirms Helix Partners will accept the Interim Attestation Letter plus the 2023 Type II report as evidence for the 2024-09-01 renewal, provided the attestation explicitly states coverage through 2024-09-01 and lists the evidence items Karthik outlined.

Attached: Interim_Attestation_Letter_2024-06-17.pdf (signed), updated Procurement_Cutover_Checklist.xlsx (with our internal acceptance checklist and PO milestones). Please confirm the contact for evidence handoff (S3 link or secure SharePoint) and whether we should expect any additional vendor questionnaires (SIG/CAIQ) before PO issuance.

Acceptance note: "Helix Partners accepts the Interim Attestation Letter (dated 2024-06-17) and Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report for 2023 as sufficient evidence of control coverage through the renewal effective date of 2024-09-01."

If all good, Procurement will proceed with final PO execution this week.

Thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best regards,
Sarah Collins
Senior Procurement Lead
Helix Partners

Attachments: Interim_Attestation_Letter_2024-06-17.pdf; Procurement_Cutover_Checklist.xlsx
